name: 找到所有数组中消失的数字 III
englishName: Find All Numbers Disappeared in an Array III
hints: Sort nums so you can find gaps between present values without checking every integer in [lower, upper].

Keep a cursor cur starting at lower. Skip values below cur and stop at values above upper. For each remaining value x, record [cur, x - 1] if cur < x, then set cur = x + 1. After the scan, record [cur, upper] if cur <= upper.
